member.name: T:CountryData.Globalization.Data.CountryDataLoader
member.summary: Provides functionality to load country data from embedded JSON resources.
member.remarks: This class is responsible for reading country information from an embedded JSON file, deserializing it into objects, and enriching the data with Unicode emoji flags. The country data includes ISO 3166-1 codes, names, phone codes, and administrative regions.

member.name: F:CountryData.Globalization.Data.CountryDataLoader.DataFileName
member.summary: The fully qualified name of the embedded JSON resource containing country data.

member.name: M:CountryData.Globalization.Data.CountryDataLoader.LoadCountries
member.summary: Loads all country data from the embedded JSON resource.
member.returns: A read-only list of objects containing comprehensive country information including ISO codes, names, phone codes, regions, and Unicode emoji flags.
member.exception: Thrown when the embedded country data resource cannot be found in the assembly.
Thrown when the JSON data cannot be deserialized into country objects.

remarks.para:
This method performs the following operations:
Reads the embedded JSON resource from the assembly
Deserializes the JSON into a list of objects
Enriches each country with its Unicode emoji flag
Returns the data as a read-only collection
The deserialization is case-insensitive to ensure flexibility with different JSON formats. If deserialization fails or returns null, an empty list is returned instead of throwing an exception.

member.exception: Thrown when the specified embedded resource cannot be found in the executing assembly.

remarks.para: This method uses reflection to access embedded resources at runtime. The resource must be configured as an embedded resource in the project file to be accessible.
The method properly disposes of the stream and reader resources using 'using' statements to prevent memory leaks.

member.name: M:CountryData.Globalization.Data.CountryDataLoader.GetCountryFlag(System.String)
member.summary: Converts an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code into its corresponding Unicode emoji flag.
member.param: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., "US", "GB", "JP"). Case-insensitive - will be converted to uppercase automatically.
member.returns: A string containing the Unicode emoji flag for the specified country. Returns an empty string if the input is null, empty, or whitespace.

remarks.para: This method converts country codes to emoji flags using Unicode Regional Indicator Symbols. Each letter in the country code is converted to its corresponding regional indicator symbol by adding 0x1F1A5 to the character's Unicode value.

The conversion formula: Regional Indicator = Character + 0x1F1A5
'A' (0x41) becomes 🇦 (0x1F1E6)
'B' (0x42) becomes 🇧 (0x1F1E7)
etc.

example.code: var usFlag = GetCountryFlag("US"); // Returns "🇺🇸" var gbFlag = GetCountryFlag("gb"); // Returns "🇬🇧" (case-insensitive) var empty = GetCountryFlag(""); // Returns "" var jpFlag = GetCountryFlag("JP"); // Returns "🇯🇵"

member.summary: High-performance implementation of with intelligent caching and indexing.

remarks.para: This provider uses lazy initialization and pre-built indexes to achieve optimal performance:

item.description: Dictionary lookups for O(1) country code searches
Pre-cached RegionInfo objects to avoid repeated construction
Pre-cached CultureInfo objects to avoid repeated enumeration
